versions.changelog:
Initial release of lineage-skill.

- Converts diverse learning materials (courses, books, video, audio, PDFs, slides, transcripts, OCR, notes) into source-grounded learning Skills.
- Follows a structured method from source capture to learner graduation, ensuring source traceability and robust mastery validation.
- Supports CoursePackage migration, teacher method extraction, learning paths, assessment/practice bank creation, and private learner workflows.
- Details technical invariants, provider configuration, and step-by-step commands for compiling, merging, and migrating learning materials.
- Maintains separation between teacher assets and learner data; enforces privacy and review/evidence protocols.
